themes.nameEn: requests for social features and notifications

reviews.text:
Life changing. I’ve become addicted to the feeling I get during and after class! All of the instructors are amazing and encouraging. Yogabox has changed my life and one of the only classes I’ve taken that has stuck. It’s challenging and relaxing . It’s making me want to stay disciplined. My body has changed over this last year going consistently and my
Mindset has also shifted to a healthier happier version of myself. I just love Yogabox so much and so grateful the Oceanside location popped up with it did :) thank you !

inaccurate & glichy. ugh! i want to love the app as much as I love the classes but it’s just not there. Biggest complaint: the classes taken / classes taken in past 30 days is never accurate.
why is something as simple as a running total constantly glitching 😭

Quirky. The app does not show what classes you are waitlisted to in the summary schedule view. It also does not show you classes past 2 weeks out. The previous app allowed you to view, not book, the schedule for the month so you could see the special events happening and plan your schedule.
HRH.. Oh! I thought you meant MY title. I was received with genuine friendliness in a way that disarmed my nervousness after many decades of not having taken a yoga class. That’s enough.
Thankful. Enhanced my life in every way
Filter Function Error. Generally good app but wish in the booking tab/schedule you there was an option to filter by Pilates Sculpt class type.
Delivers.. So happy with this studio. The music, the lighting, the teachers, the sweat. Just pitch perfect. Thank you.
PB yogabox. Best place to workout with amazing instructors!! Thank you!
An app I don’t mind being addicted to. I probably would not of gotten so into yoga if it wasn’t so convenient to book my appointments through this app! Thank you

Booked classes and previous classes do not show. This is really annoying that my pre-booked classes do not show. This just happened all of a sudden. I have a membership from yoga box and have been using this app for some time now. And when I try to see my previously booked classes that turns up empty too. This app has so many bugs it’s atrocious that no one bothered to do a user acceptance testing on this poorly copy & paste app from this Geisler Young developer.

Should have a grace period. After my experience today, I will not be returning. When there’s no one at the front desk, people often walk in late and still join class and I’ve never done that myself. However, when someone is at the front desk, the rules suddenly become strict and only seem to apply to certain people.

I arrived at 10:03 for a class that started at 10:00. A reasonable grace period of at least five minutes should be allowed, especially considering others have been allowed to join later without issue. The inconsistency and lack of fairness in how the rules are enforced are disappointing

Required birthday after multiple classes. I’ve been using this app for almost a month. Have a monthly subscription to Yoga Box then ran into the issue where this app would not let me book until I had submitted my birthday. I already have an account and had been able to book, but to suddenly stagnate my account until I provided this information is not only misleading, but predatory. Otherwise has been a good experience, but a bait and switch deserves one star.
Slow and buggy. App load speeds are extremely slow rather to similar apps. Frequency error messages. Website is equally bad. Lose lose.

My favorite Yoga Studio in PB. I have been coming to Yoga Box for years, enjoying their heated vinyasa flow classes. My favorite instructors are Martine, Mary, Janelle, and Nicole. They all unique challenging flows, great music and amazing vibes. If you’re looking to get a great workout with amazing instructors, Yoga Box is the place to be in PB! It’s my happy place!
This is THE Place!. If you’re looking for an awesome yoga experience, this is the place. The staff is phenomenal, both in their instruction and in their kind spirit.
Great. Great🤙🏾

Not cool. Change your cancellation policy. It’s clear the company is just trying to profit on people not being able to make a class without 8hrs notice. Update it to allow 2-3 cancels per month for YB members. Thank you.

Great app minus one thing. Please offer the option to swap classes, not just cancel.

Otherwise, I love yoga box and recommend it to all yogis that enjoy hot yoga classes.

Yoga Box the perfect challenge. I had such a great work out my first hot yoga at yoga box . My muscles felt so relaxed and the temperature was so challenging where I know my lungs will get better to incorporate this into my workout routine too. I feel lifting weights will also be a good balance to this . Though I only made it 3/4 through I cant wait to grow at this practice which I feel will be never ending journey . The red light therapy too was a benefit to skin health with the sweating cleansing element I look forward to having.

Amazing classes - Recommend!. Heat is perfect, instructors are always wonderful. Classes full easily so book in advance. Sometimes the flow is very fast paced which makes it difficult to hold poses but other than that I have zero complaints:)
App could use some improvement. The app could use some updating. I wish I could add my friends on it and send them links to classes so we could sign up together.
Easy peasy. Fastest I’ve ever booked a class.

Functional but barebones. Yoga box could make this app much better. Consider adding:

- the ability to favorite certain instructors
- notifications if the teacher changes (there’s going to be a substitute)
- waitlist functionality for full classes
- better descriptions for each instructor’s classes (not all sculpts are the same. Why is Andre the only teacher who gets marked intermediate?)
- the ability to rate classes
- the ability to contact YogaBox in app 
- show how full each class currently is

Basic App. The app is ok. Pretty basic. Would be great to have a more interactive app with features and enhancements like tips for at home meditation or daily motivation. But more importantly find a way for consumers to share their experiences on a social and invite friends!
YogaSix imitators. This is a cheap copy of YogaSix… same price, lower quality
Review. Andre and Sarah are wonderful instructors
This is it!. Amazing instructors, great schedule and easy app- the best.

Yoga sculpt is awesome. I would always tell people that yoga sculpt seemed super ridiculous and super extra. Well it’s definitely those things. It’s ridiculously hard and challenging. It’s super extra! The extra push I needed. It got me to the point of feeling like I might die, which I think is very important in the human experience. Helps us remember we are ALIVE! And we experience PAIN , so for that I’m grateful for yoga sculpt! Remember yoga is always your own practice so do what you can handle <3

Great app and great studio. I just started going to yoga box in north park and I love it! They’re very friendly and it’s a nice studio. This app has been helpful and easy to use, plus I like how I can see what classes I’ve taken or book them out so smoothly.

Improved but can’t see how full the class will be anymore. Please bring back the ability to see how full the class is. I prefer classes with a little breathing room, and now I can’t tell if it’s going to be packed. 

Love the ability to filter by studio and teacher but it was a little cumbersome to clear filters since there is no button for this(?)
